other_conditions: Student must be enrolled in a government school in Haryana
Student must be studying in Class 8, 9, 10, 11, or 12
Student must be part of the phased distribution plan as per the Haryana Government’s rollout strategy
Class 11 tablets are issued only after the student clears the Class 10 board examinations
benefits_summary: Free Android tablets with pre‑loaded educational content and 2 GB of free data per month are provided to eligible students in Classes 8‑12.
